goal: Implement Slice S3 of Initiative lane-mode-followups: both Hosts accept a resume that passes lane_offers without max_parallel, the Pi max_parallel schema matches Claude Code's integer minimum 1, and the Pi loop surface registers lane-steward.

acceptance.assertion: Per Interfaces of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (source: repository evidence, Review of parallel-batch-lanes-s2-lane-integration findings review-1 and review-4): (a) a start_unattended_batch call with lane_offers and no max_parallel on a persisted v2 batch resumes it with the recorded max_parallel on both Hosts, and the same call on a batch with no v2 record is refused before any gate opens with a stable reason; (b) the Pi tool schema refuses a non-integer or sub-1 max_parallel at the schema, equal to the Claude Code input schema, with the typebox stub used by the packaged-tree tests extended if the chosen schema form needs it; (c) the Pi loop surface accepts lane-steward as a target and refuses an unknown target as before. Positive: Claude Code and Pi return equal reports for the same lane resume fixture. Negative: max_parallel 1.5, 0 and a lane_offers-only fresh start are refused before any gate; a resume with a different max_parallel is still refused with batch_parallel_mismatch. Bound: the declared tool parameters stay exactly initiative_slug, max_parallel and lane_offers and the generated Claude bundle matches a fresh generate. Agreed seams: tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/packaged-contract-tool-surface.test.ts, tests/imm-canary-work-contract.test.ts, tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.
